reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Programme de renforcement de la prévention et de la prise en charge du VIH/SIDA et de la tuberculose en RCA - Central African Republic (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Central African Republic, TB/HIV, La Croix-Rouge française (CRF)This program has the following goals: Contribute to improving the health of the Central African population by accelerating the fight against HIV and ending the AIDS epidemic through quality interventions implemented in full respect of human rights and dignity.. Reduce TB-related mortality by 35% by 2021 compared to 2015 levels.. The objectives of this program are: Accelerate access to ARV treatment for PLHIV, children and adolescents (10-19 y.-o.) by 2020. Accelerate the elimination of mother-to-child transmission of HIV by 2020. Reinforce prevention among adolescents, youth and key populations by 2020. Reinforce testing and adequate treatment among new cases of TB by 2020. Reinforce testing and adequate treatment among MDR-TB cases by 2020. Reinforce treatment of co-infected TB-HIV cases by 2020

Percentage of people living with HIV newly enrolled in HIV care started on TB preventive therapy
Percentage of men who have sex with men that have received an HIV test during the reporting period and know their results
Percentage of HIV-exposed infants receiving a virological test for HIV within 2 months of birth
Percentage of people living with HIV and on ART, who have a suppressed viral load at 12 months (<1000 copies/ml)
Percentage of men who have sex with men reached with HIV prevention programs - defined package of services
Percentage of sex workers that have received an HIV test during the reporting period and know their results
Number of cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB that began second-line treatment
Percentage of pregnant women who know their HIV status
Number of TB cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB notified
Percentage of HIV-positive women who received ART during pregnancy and/or labour and delivery
Percentage of people living with HIV currently receiving antiretroviral therapy
Number of notified cases of all forms of TB (i.e. bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed), new and relapse cases

Percentage of adolescent girls and young women (AGYW) reached with HIV prevention programs- defined package of services
Percentage of sex workers reached with HIV prevention programs - defined package of services
Proportion of facility reports received over the reports expected during the reporting period
Percentage of HIV-positive new and relapse TB patients on ART during TB treatment

Treatment success rate of all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, new and relapse

Percentage of adults and children with HIV, known to be on treatment 12 months after initiation of antiretroviral therapy
Treatment success rate of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB: Percentage of patients with RR and/or MDR-TB successfully treated

Number of new HIV infections per 1000 uninfected population
